description:
Input for assess_trend.

Returns a time series and heuristic trend classification for one
jurisdiction / pathogen / signal combination.

jurisdiction.description: US state code (e.g. 'GA'), territory (e.g. 'PR'), or 'USA'/'national'. Case-insensitive; common aliases accepted.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

pathogen.description: Respiratory pathogen: 'influenza', 'covid19', or 'rsv'. Aliases: 'flu' → influenza, 'covid'/'sars-cov-2' → covid19.

lookback_weeks.description: Number of weeks of history to retrieve and display (4–52). Trend uses the most recent 4 of these weeks.
lookback_weeks.title: Lookback Weeks

as_of.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) to restrict analysis to data on or before this date. Omit to use the most recent available data. Useful for reproducible demos and evaluation.
as_of.title: As Of
